comment: TED expert-search queries. {SINCE} is replaced with YYYYMMDD lookback. Keep queries competence-narrow; do not search generic IT.

queries.label: XR/VR/AR Training in DE/AT/DK/NL
queries.query: (FT~"virtual reality" OR FT~"Virtual Reality" OR FT~"virtuelle Realität" OR FT~"Virtuelle Realität" OR FT~"VR-Training" OR FT~"VR Training" OR FT~"augmented reality" OR FT~"Augmented Reality" OR FT~"extended reality" OR FT~"Extended Reality" OR FT~"immersive") AND (buyer-country=DEU OR buyer-country=AUT OR buyer-country=DNK OR buyer-country=NLD) AND (notice-type=cn-standard OR notice-type=cn-social OR notice-type=pin-cfc-standard) AND PD>={SINCE} SORT BY publication-date DESC

queries.label: Educational software CPV in DE (UKSH-class)
queries.query: classification-cpv=48190000* AND (buyer-country=DEU OR place-of-performance=DE*) AND (notice-type=cn-standard OR notice-type=cn-social OR notice-type=pin-cfc-standard) AND PD>={SINCE} SORT BY publication-date DESC
